title: Crafted BMP upload amplifies into hundreds of MB of decode memory

discovery.evidence: upload bytes reach Image.open().convert() after a size-only check

validation.confidence_rationale: PoC reproduced the advisory's memory peak through the exact call pattern
validation.evidence: 1084-byte BI_RLE8 file peaked at 878 MB RSS under a 4 GB address cap
validation.counterevidence_or_proof_gap: No content-type gate before decode; none found

attack_path.severity_rationale: impact medium (availability, bounds-safe) x likelihood medium (local_network) gives low
attack_path.change_conditions: Proof of internet exposure would raise likelihood to high and severity to medium

title: Oversized upload bypasses the 100 MiB cap

discovery.evidence: only one size check guards the handler

validation.confidence_rationale: the check runs on the full body before any other use
validation.counterevidence_or_proof_gap: The cap is enforced on every path into the decode

attack_path.severity_rationale: control verified; no path skips it
attack_path.change_conditions: A second entry point that decodes without the check
